intended_object: A property of a differential field extension K/F. Suppose a ∈ F can be written as a = v′ + ∑ cᵢ·uᵢ′/uᵢ, where the cᵢ are constants of F and u, v ∈ K. The property says that a can then also be written this way with u, v taken in F. The module documentation says plainly that "this definition doesn't appear in the literature, and we introduce it as part of the formalization of Liouville's theorem".
